Tango fragment metadata, sequence, chunk, control, and timestamp helpers.

# Purpose
This header file defines the core data layout and helper functions for Tango message fragments. It sets fixed sizes for fragment payload chunks and fragment metadata, defines the `fd_frag_meta_t` union for atomic and SIMD-friendly access, and provides inline helpers for sequence number comparison, chunk address conversion, control-bit packing, and timestamp compression. The code is narrow in scope and is intended to be imported by other C++ or C code that implements message publication, caching, and reassembly.
